title: Callout zoom
summary: A ring pulses on a detail too small to read; a round lens grows out of it and shows it magnified, tied back by a thin line.

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

params.name: format
params.description: output size; the layout recomposes for each

usage:
npx paper-motion add callout-zoom --name my-callout-zoom
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-callout-zoom/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-callout-zoom/scene.html --motion-blur 5
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
Recomposes for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1: set `format` and the layout and camera follow.
when: a setting or value that is too small on screen
show a detail without cutting away
